description: This PHP source file handles the saving logic for scheduler jobs in the SuiteCRM project. It initializes a new scheduler bean, populates it from POST data, calculates scheduling intervals, manages job types, saves the scheduler, and redirects to the appropriate view.

classes.name: Bean
classes.description: A generic CRM data object used for storing and retrieving scheduler, contact, or other entity data within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the scheduler bean to the database, updating the record with current properties.
